coding_method: Assistant review of the complete captured answer and seven recorded inline links; no external fact-check, independent human double-coding or webpage visits.
coding_scope: All substantively named tools/services/features, including input sources and channels. Generic methods and supplied target platforms are separate. Supporting publishers are not included as discovered tool recommendations.

notes: Seven answer links are not the same as the 90-hit source badge or a complete retrieval-panel inventory.
Native activity reportedly included four, three and two searches, but only seven exact query labels were captured; the observed query list is partial.
A workspace-explored activity label was observed. Its source contents and influence are unestablished, so account-context isolation is not audited.
The plain copied body has no inline citation positions. Seven native link targets are preserved; exact claim-to-marker mapping is not exhaustively established.
Displayed targets lacked URL schemes and were standardized to HTTPS during capture; no destination was visited to verify the scheme.
All numerical thresholds, causal-sounding engine claims, tool coverage and free-status statements remain Grok claims.
capture_scope.public_copy_note: Body length and source hash describe this redacted public record. Original citation position indexes are omitted; semantic judgments are retained.

coding_cautions: Tool-set comparisons should preserve role labels: score checkers, analytics, prompt inputs and distribution channels serve different tasks.
False citation values mean no own-content citation observed among the captured answer links, not independently proven absence from all uncollected retrieval results.
The original answer distinguishes mentions and citations, but does not explicitly operationalize active recommendations as a separate third metric.
No full source-publisher C/M/R census was conducted; five supporting non-tool publishers are not counted as tools.
